# opnsense_bind_forward_domain (Resource)

Zones whose queries BIND forwards to other servers (**Services ▸ BIND ▸ Configuration ▸ Forward Zones**, plugin `os-bind`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_bind_forward_domain" "corp" {
  domainname    = "corp.example"
  forwardserver = ["10.20.0.53"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domainname` (String) Set the name for this zone. Both forward and reverse zones may be specified, i.e. example.com or 0.168.192.in-addr.arpa.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) This will enable or disable this zone. Defaults to `true`.
- `forwardserver` (Set of String) Set the IP address of server to forward requests to. Defaults to `[]`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the BIND forward zone.
